question: In Table 1, which technologies have the highest and the lowest upper bound of estimated energy density improvement, and how far apart are those bounds?

trace.query: SELECT row_no, col_no, text FROM cells WHERE table_id='p10.T1' ORDER BY row_no, col_no

SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=10 AND (text ILIKE '%^a%' OR text ILIKE 'a %' OR text ILIKE 'b %' OR text ILIKE '%Section 8%' OR text ILIKE '%Section 9%' OR text ILIKE '%Estimated energy%' OR text ILIKE '%Wh/kg%' OR text ILIKE '%Process Technology%' OR text ILIKE '%Protocols%' OR text ILIKE '%Electrode Processing%' OR text ILIKE '%(Uncalendered)%' OR text ILIKE '%estimat%' OR text ILIKE '%Figure%') ORDER BY id

WITH hi AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text,'-\s*(\d+)',1) AS INTEGER) AS up FROM cells WHERE table_id='p10.T1' AND row_no=12 AND col_no=5),
lo AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text,'-\s*(\d+)',1) AS INTEGER) AS up FROM cells WHERE table_id='p10.T1' AND row_no=10 AND col_no=5)
SELECT (SELECT up FROM hi) - (SELECT up FROM lo) AS diff

SELECT a.up - b.up AS diff, a.up AS hi_upper, b.up AS lo_upper FROM (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text,'-\s*(\d+)',1) AS INTEGER) AS up FROM cells WHERE table_id='p10.T1' AND row_no=12 AND col_no=5) a, (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text,'-\s*(\d+)',1) AS INTEGER) AS up FROM cells WHERE table_id='p10.T1' AND row_no=10 AND col_no=5) b
